Hi Samantha — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a couple asks to help us scope a pilot that maps to your procurement timeline:

- Takeaway: Aeris wants a short proof-of-concept (3 weeks) to validate latency/throughput for chat and retrieval use cases. Primary success metrics: 95th pct latency < 300ms and cost per 1k tokens under your target.
- Immediate asks for us to prepare accurate proposal: please confirm the economic/budget owner (person who signs the PO) and the security/compliance contact we should engage for SOC2 and network requirements.

I’ve attached our security checklist and a blank mutual action plan to populate with timeline and deliverables. Proposed next steps:
1) If Trevor is the budget owner, can we schedule a 30-min call with him this week to align on timelines and approval gates?
2) Security intro (1:1) with your security lead so we can share SOC2 report and encryption specifics.
3) We’ll follow up with a tailored cost estimate and an MAP populated with milestone dates.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood-Security-Checklist.pdf (PDF)] [Attachment: Mutual-Action-Plan-Aeris.xlsx (Excel)]

Thanks — if you prefer, I can send two separate invites (finance + security) to keep the asks focused.

—Rishi
